head: bcaf7a2538a10176c89dd1fddddafbe29826b56e
scope: BackgroundColor source audit, Windows 2.1.28.0 Galahad II LCDV2
evidence_kind: source-derived; no renderer or hardware execution
observations: UI exposes SolidColor, HorizontalGradient, VerticalGradient, RadialGradient
Gradient settings retain two colors and Flip independently per type
GetConfigs sends Theme.Type=Color, ColorType, Colors, Flip
Overlay GetConfigs suffix after object obj is identical to ImageVideo after stripping decompiler comments
Active JS ColorShowMode reverses color list for Flip; horizontal first-to-second left/right; vertical top/bottom
Radial center is canvas center, radius to corner; nested filled circles from outer radius toward center step 2; lerpColor first/second by radius/max
Linux LcdTheme.background and renderer currently support only a solid RGB color
